# Discovery 

# Prepare data for CLAM preprocessing

## Full metadata processing

```{r}
metadata_all <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")
#metadata_all <- read_csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")
```

```{r}
# Add TMA ID
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(metadata_all$grid,"x",metadata_all$x,"y",metadata_all$y),"NA","")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "x","X")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "y","Y")
metadata_all[is.na(metadata_all$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data
```

```{r}
metadata_all$subtype_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), metadata_all$subtype, "other")
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"
```

```{r}
## Update survival censoring
metadata_all$status_OS <- ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

metadata_all$OS_months <- metadata_all$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories
metadata_all$pT_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$pT_simple))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- metadata_all$ISUP
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$ISUP))
metadata_all$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", metadata_all$lymphocytes)
```


```{r}
# Make sure stage, grade and necrose are encoded as characters
metadata_all$pT_simple <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_simple))
metadata_all$pT_combined <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_combined))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_simple))
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_combined))

metadata_all$necrose <- as.character(paste0("NE",metadata_all$necrose))

# Revert NAs
metadata_all$necrose[metadata_all$necrose == "NENA"] <- NA

metadata_all$ISUP_simple[metadata_all$ISUP_simple == "GNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$ISUP_combined[metadata_all$ISUP_combined == "GNA"] <- NA

metadata_all$pT_simple[metadata_all$pT_simple == "TNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$pT_combined[metadata_all$pT_combined == "TNA"] <- NA
```

```{r}
metadata_selected <- metadata_all %>% select(PID, TMA_id, subtype_combined, gender, age, age_bin, type, status_OS, OS_months, pT_simple, pT_combined, ISUP_simple, ISUP_combined, necrose) %>% as.data.frame
```

```{r}

metadata_selected$PDL1_score <- sce_PDL1$PDL1_score[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_PDL1$PID)]
```


### Add data modality information 

```{r}
# HE data
HE_images <- data.frame(slide_id = list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/"),
           TMA_id = str_split(str_split(list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/"), "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2], ".tif", simplify = TRUE)[,1])

metadata_selected$HE_data <- metadata_selected$TMA_id %in% HE_images$TMA_id

# IMC - ccRCC data only
sce_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_05.rds")
metadata_selected$IMC_TU_data <- metadata_selected$PID %in% unique(sce_TU$PID) 

sce_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas_full/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")
metadata_selected$IMC_T_data <- metadata_selected$PID %in% unique(sce_T$PID) 

sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_06.rds")
metadata_selected$IMC_MY_data <- metadata_selected$PID %in% unique(sce_MY$PID) 

# Targeted sequencing 
mut_anno <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_full_withmeta.csv")
metadata_selected$GEN_data <- metadata_selected$PID %in% unique(mut_anno$PID) 

# MALDI-MSI data (TO BE UPDATED WHEN NEW DATA ARRIVES)
maldi_data <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas_full/projects/RCC_DL/metadata_general.csv")
metadata_selected$MSI_data <- metadata_selected$PID %in% (maldi_data %>% filter(!is.na(metabolic_subtype)) %>% pull(PID) %>% unique())

# Survival information
```

### Rich cohort overview

ccRCC only 

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(foreach)
library(ggsci)
library(RColorBrewer)

#Filter for columns to visualize
Meta_viz <- metadata_selected %>% filter(subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% dplyr::select(PID, gender, age_bin, pT_simple, ISUP_simple, necrose, surv_data, IMC_TU_data, IMC_T_data, IMC_MY_data, HE_data, MSI_data, GEN_data)
                                         
Meta_viz <- as.data.frame(lapply(Meta_viz, as.character))
Meta_viz[is.na(Meta_viz)] <- "Unknown"

#Arrange
Meta_viz <- Meta_viz %>% arrange(desc(pT_simple), desc(ISUP_simple), desc(necrose))

colors <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/color.rds")
names(colors$pT_simple)[1:4] <- paste0("T",names(colors$pT_simple)[1:4])
names(colors$ISUP)[1:4] <- paste0("G",names(colors$ISUP)[1:4])
names(colors$necrose)[1:2] <- paste0("NE",names(colors$necrose)[1:2])

#Color scheme
col <- list(PID = colors$PID, 
            gender = colors$gender, 
            age_bin = colors$age_bin, 
            pT_simple = colors$pT_simple, 
            ISUP_simple = colors$ISUP, 
            necrose = colors$necrose, 
            surv_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")),
            IMC_TU_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
            IMC_T_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
            IMC_MY_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
            HE_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
            MSI_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE")), 
            GEN_data = setNames(c("black","grey"), c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
            )

#Heatmap Annotation
sample_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(PID = Meta_viz$PID,
                                gender = Meta_viz$gender,
                                age_bin = Meta_viz$age_bin,
                                pT_simple = Meta_viz$pT_simple,
                                ISUP_simple = Meta_viz$ISUP_simple,
                                necrose = Meta_viz$necrose,
                                surv_data = Meta_viz$surv_data,
                                IMC_TU_data = Meta_viz$IMC_TU_data,
                                IMC_T_data = Meta_viz$IMC_T_data, 
                                IMC_MY_data = Meta_viz$IMC_MY_data,
                                HE_data = Meta_viz$HE_data, 
                                MSI_data = Meta_viz$MSI_data,
                                GEN_data = Meta_viz$GEN_data,
                                col = col,
                                border = T,
                                na_col = "black",
                                gap = unit(5, "points"),
                                show_annotation_name = T,
                                show_legend = c(PID = FALSE)
                                )%v%NULL

#Display plot
#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/cohort_overview/ccRCC_cohort_heatmap.pdf", width = 11, height = 4, onefile = FALSE)
draw(sample_anno)
#dev.off()
```

### Rich panel overview


```{r}
all_markers <- c(rownames(sce_MY), rownames(sce_T), rownames(sce_TU))

all_markers[all_markers == "Ir191"] <- "DNA1"
all_markers[all_markers == "Ir193"] <- "DNA2"
all_markers[all_markers == "PDL1"] <- "CD274"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD279"] <- "PD1"
all_markers[all_markers == "Tim-3"] <- "Tim3"
all_markers[all_markers == "Vim"] <- "Vimentin"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD45"] <- "CD45RO_RA"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD45RO"] <- "CD45RO_RA"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD31"] <- "CD31_vWF"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD31/vWF"] <- "CD31_vWF"
all_markers[all_markers == "clCas/PARP"] <- "clCAS_PARP"

all_markers

panel <- c(rep("MY",length(rownames(sce_MY))), rep("T",length(rownames(sce_T))), rep("TU",length(rownames(sce_TU))))

count <- as.data.frame(table(all_markers))


panel_anno <- data.frame(marker = all_markers, 
                         panel = panel)

panel_anno$count <- count$Freq[match(panel_anno$marker, count$all_markers)]

panel_anno$panel_shared <- ifelse(panel_anno$count == "3", "shared", panel_anno$panel)



library(dplyr)

panel_anno_red <- panel_anno %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  summarise(
    count = mean(count),
    panel_combined = paste0(unique(panel), collapse = "_"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Marker categories
panel_anno_red$marker_cat <- ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("H3", "DNA1", "DNA2"), "DNA",
       ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CA9", "panCK", "VCAM1"), "Tumor_GEN",
              ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("SMA", "CD31_vWF", "Vimentin"), "Non_Immune_GEN",
                     ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("MPO", "CD3", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD20", "CD45RO_RA", "CD11c", "CD68", "CD38", "HLADR", "CD56", "CD274"), "Immune_GEN",
                            ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("TMEM173", "CD73", "IRF4", "CD44", "CXCL12", "CXCL13", "CCL19", "CCL21"), "Immunoregulatory", 
                                          ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CD16", "CD303","CD163", "DCLAMP", "CD11b", "MMP9", "CCR2", "Arginase", "CD33", "VISTA", "CD209", "CD206", "CD15", "IDO1"), "Myeloid_SPE", 
                                                 ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("GATA3", "4-1BB", "CD45RA", "LAG-3", "PD1", "CD7", "GranB", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "CD278", "GITR", "CD134", "Tbet", "NKG2A", "GranK", "Tim3"), "Tcell_SPE", 
                                                        ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("GPX4", "PDK4", "PKM2", "IDH2", "GLUT1", "Fumarase", "GLUD1_2", "S6")
, "Tumor_Metabolism_SPE", 
ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("HIF1a", "CD140b", "BRG1", "HIF2a", "VEGFR1", "VHL"), "Tumor_Hypoxia_Angio_SPE", 
       ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("NFKB", "p53", "MYC", "EGFR", "RB1", "mTOR", "CyclinD1"), "Tumor_Oncogenic_SPE", 
              ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CD44", "ICAM1", "CD10", "AuroraKinaseA"), "Tumor_Other_SPE",
                     ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("clCAS_PARP", "Ki67"), "State", NA))))))))))))

# Colors
col <- list(panel = setNames(c("black","#929882","#ba8874","#596db4", "#F2B342", "#317EC2", "#825CA6"), 
                             c("MY_T_TU", "MY_T", "MY_TU", "T_TU", "MY", "T", "TU")),
            cat = setNames(c("#33A02C", "#B2DF8A", "#A6CEE3","#FDBF6F", "#B15928", "#1F78B4","#FFFF99","#6A3D9A",  "#E31A1C", "#CAB2D6", "#FB9A99", "#FF7F00"),
                           c("DNA", "State", "Immune_GEN", "Immunoregulatory", "Non_Immune_GEN", "Tcell_SPE", "Myeloid_SPE", "Tumor_GEN", "Tumor_Hypoxia_Angio_SPE", "Tumor_Metabolism_SPE", "Tumor_Oncogenic_SPE", "Tumor_Other_SPE"
)),
count = colorRamp2(c(min(panel_anno_red$count),max(panel_anno_red$count)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Greys")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Greys")[3]))
)

# Arrange
panel_anno_red <- panel_anno_red %>% arrange(-count, panel_combined, marker_cat)

# Plot
#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/cohort_overview/ccRCC_IMCpanel_heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 3, onefile = FALSE)
HeatmapAnnotation(count = panel_anno_red$count,
                  cat = panel_anno_red$marker_cat,
                  panel = panel_anno_red$panel_combined,
                  marker = anno_text(panel_anno_red$marker),
                  col = col,
                  border = T,
                  na_col = "black",
                  gap = unit(5, "points"),
                  show_annotation_name = T)%v%NULL
#dev.off()
```

### Survival overview 

```{r}
metadata_surv <- metadata_selected %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_PL$PID & subtype_combined == "ccRCC")

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1, data = metadata_surv)

summary(fit)$table["median"]
summary(fit)$table["0.95LCL"]
summary(fit)$table["0.95UCL"]
summary(fit)$table["events"]

#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/cohort_overview/ccRCC_survival_all.pdf", width = 7, height = 4, onefile = FALSE)
ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time (Months)",
  ylab = "Survival probability (OS)",
  risk.table.col = "strata", 
  linetype = "strata",
  surv.median.line = "hv", 
  palette = "black",
  ggtheme = theme_classic()
)
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ pT_combined, data = metadata_surv)
print(fit)

fit_p1 <- ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("#ABCFE5", "#08306B"),
          conf.int = TRUE)

# ISUP grading
fit_1 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ISUP_combined, data = metadata_surv)
print(fit_1)

fit_p2 <- ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          conf.int = TRUE,
          palette = c("#FC9F81", "#67000D")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
)

# Necrosis
fit_2 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ necrose, data = metadata_surv)
print(fit_2)

fit_p3 <- ggsurvplot(fit_2,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(),
          conf.int = TRUE, # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("#bf8cf0", "#3F007D")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
)

#PDL1 score
fit_3 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ PDL1_score, data = metadata_surv)
print(fit_3)

fit_p4 <- ggsurvplot(fit_3,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("#AADBAB","#00441B"),
          conf.int = TRUE
)

library(patchwork)
#pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/cohort_overview/ccRCC_CCcat_survival_all.pdf", width = 10, height = 8, onefile = FALSE)
arrange_ggsurvplots(list(fit_p1, fit_p2, fit_p3, fit_p4), 
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
#dev.off()
```

# CPTAC 

# Prepare data for CLAM preprocessing

## Pre-processing

```{r}
CPTAC_meta <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/CPTAC/CPTAC_meta_raw.xlsx")
```

```{r}
CPTAC_meta <- separate_rows(CPTAC_meta, Slide_ID, sep = ";")

# Survival
CPTAC_meta$OS_days <- CPTAC_meta$`Overall survival, days`
CPTAC_meta$DFS_days <- CPTAC_meta$`Recurrence-free survival, days`
CPTAC_meta$status_DFS <- CPTAC_meta$`Recurrence status (1, yes; 0, no)`
CPTAC_meta$status_OS <- CPTAC_meta$`Survival status (1, dead; 0, alive)`

# Clinical
CPTAC_meta$ISUP_simple <- CPTAC_meta$Tumor_grade
CPTAC_meta$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(CPTAC_meta$ISUP_simple %in% c("G1","G2"),"G1/2", ifelse(CPTAC_meta$ISUP_simple %in% c("G3","G4"), "G3/4", NA))

CPTAC_meta$pT_simple <- str_remove(CPTAC_meta$Tumor_stage, "Stage ")
roman_to_arabic <- c("I" = 1, "II" = 2, "III" = 3, "IV" = 4)
CPTAC_meta$pT_simple <- unname(roman_to_arabic)[match(CPTAC_meta$pT_simple, names(roman_to_arabic))]
CPTAC_meta$pT_combined <- ifelse(CPTAC_meta$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(CPTAC_meta$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", NA))

necrose_name <- c("0", "1", NA)
names(necrose_name) <- unique(CPTAC_meta$NECROSIS)
CPTAC_meta$necrose <- unname(necrose_name)[match(CPTAC_meta$NECROSIS, names(necrose_name))]
```

```{r}
write.xlsx(CPTAC_meta, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/CPTAC/CPTAC_meta_clean.xlsx")
```
